product_overview: A warehouse management web application for logging in, viewing operational dashboards, and managing dispatch-related tasks. It supports internal users across warehouse, project, and operations roles through a web frontend.
core_goals: Log into the system with valid user credentials
View the main dashboard overview after authentication
Manage dispatch records within the application
Access core operational areas through authenticated pages

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows a user to authenticate into the warehouse management system using credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the authenticated area
Navigate to /login -> Fill in username or email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See validation feedback if required fields are left blank

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Provides authenticated users with an overview of key operational metrics.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Sign in with valid credentials if needed -> View overview metrics

features.name: Dispatch Management
features.description: Lets authenticated users view and edit dispatch records.
user_flows: Navigate to /dispatch -> Sign in with valid credentials if needed -> View dispatch lists -> Edit dispatch items -> See updated dispatch information
